description_en: Queries the error logs of a lightweight database instance
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-error-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --start-time 2022-09-07T04:04Z --end-time 2022-09-08T04:04Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseErrorLogs

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the lightweight database instance resides.

You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
parameters.description_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。

您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。

parameters.description_en:
The start of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` according to the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard.

> The time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the specified UTC time.
parameters.description_zh:
查询错误日志起始时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

> +8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间。
